subject: Re: Post-call recap — NovaCare decision owners & evidence asks

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-07-23T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Post-call recap — decision owners & evidence asks

Lisa — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the pilot/POC: 

Call highlights
- Primary use case: real-time triage for inbound clinical notes (latency SLOs are critical)
- Decision criteria: accuracy on named-entity extraction (esp. PHI redaction), 99th pct latency < 250ms for single-request baseline, and predictable unit cost under $0.0009/token for batched workloads
- Buying group: CISO (security + compliance), Procurement, Product lead, and central IT for networking

Immediate evidence asks you called out
1) SOC 2 report or SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted acceptable)
2) Recent penetration-test attestation / high-level findings (we can provide redacted summary)
3) Audit log capabilities & retention policy (sample schema + retention windows)
4) Data residency/controls and encryption details (KMS use & key rotation cadence)

Proposed next steps
- I will assemble the SOC2/pen-test/retention artifacts and share by EOD Thursday (7/25).
- Marissa will own the technical artifact pack and can jump on a follow-up with Rajiv if helpful.
- If Procurement wants, we can do a short (15–20m) contract/terms sync next week to surface PO timeline constraints.

Can you confirm the primary procurement contact and the CISO we should loop in? You mentioned Rajiv — is his preferred address rajiv.menon@novacare.com?

Thanks — will follow up with the artifact pack as promised.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Dylan — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming attendees and timeline from our side: 

Stakeholders to include
- Rajiv Menon (CISO) — primary security reviewer (rajiv.menon@novacare.com)
- Priya Das (Director, Procurement) — procurement lead (procurement@novacare.com)
- Mark Li (Product) — accuracy and UX owner (mark.li@novacare.com)

Priority evidence and timing
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted okay) — high priority, ideally by 7/25 as you noted.
- Pen test attestation or summary of findings — okay as a redacted statement if you cannot share full report.
- Audit log schema and retention options (we need to confirm whether logs can be exported to our SIEM)
- Short description of key encryption controls and key management

Procurement note: we typically start with a short vendor security review and then move to a formal PO. If you can share the evidence by 7/25 we’ll try to get the internal review started the week of 7/29.

Thank you — looping Rajiv and procurement on this thread.

Subject: Evidence pack: SOC2 summary, pen-test statement, retention policy (DEAL-2028-0347)

Lisa / Rajiv / Priya — attaching the artifact pack we discussed. Short summary below; attached files are redacted for confidentiality where required. 

Attachments:
- 2028-07-25_Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf — 2-page TL;DR mapping Redwood controls to NovaCare data flows (covers CC6, CC7, CC8 analogs). Redacted where necessary.
- 2028-07-25_Redwood_PenTest-Statement.txt — high-level pen-test attestation from third-party vendor; includes scope and date (redacted findings summary).
- redwood-data-retention-policy.pdf — our canonical retention windows and export options; highlights audit-log schema and export to S3/Elasticsearch.

What these cover (quick):
- SOC2: scope covers hosted API and dedicated deployments; we included notes on customer-managed VPC and on-prem packaging.
- Pen test: summary confirms no critical findings in last engagement; we can coordinate redacted excerpts with legal if you need more detail.
- Audit logs: sample schema included (timestamp, request_id, model, route, user_id_hash) and retention tiers (30d default, configurable to 365d + export).

Next steps / asks from NovaCare
- Rajiv: confirm whether the export schema works for your SIEM ingestion (I can set a short call if helpful).
- Procurement: please confirm required PO terms / lead time so we can align the pilot start date.

Drive folder (upload): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExample
HubSpot record: hubspot:contacts/2345678

If you want me to redact or expand any section, tell me which item and we'll escalate to Legal.

Thanks —
